verdict.rationale: Publishing account, credential and identity-proofing prerequisites up front is a fair question for a government e-services filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such published statement: the root serves a script-only application shell that reduces to 12 characters of text, and the long-published entry path returns 404. Neither probe shows any up-front statement of the steps required before filing.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
